speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will read it at the table. I will not have a fire at second hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Husband, there was fire here on Tuesday the fifteenth, at the north end beyond the Rother Market. Some twenty houses and barns are gone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: None of ours is touched, nor any of us hurt, and the children have each a different tale of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sadler's cousin has lost his malt-barn, and Master Quiney is writing to everyone. Do not come for this. Come for harvest, if you come.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Twice in two years. What do they do in that town?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They malt, Mistress.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then they dry it too near the thatch.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The hand does not shake on the page.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hers does not. Mine did, the first time.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Twenty houses is a town made thin. A barn is a year, and they have lost a row of years.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. A penny, and a thumb short of the notch. The fire does not move the price.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Pease in the pot. The loaf is the short thing, as it was on Sunday.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Amen. I have not the English for the longer part.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep the longer part. The bread has the sense of it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: And tomorrow? They were crying it at noon. Tomorrow, on Tower Hill.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The pease will hold. Pass the salt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The salt is here.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: You have not said if the house stays in.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have said the pease. Eat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hobbins goes at first light. He will be at Stratford four days before me.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Four days is a start a walker can live on. I will say no more than that.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Write to your wife upstairs. Five lines will do, if five is what she sent you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Five lines. Saturday, Monday, and the bridge.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The candle is on the stair.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then take it. Down here we are done with other towns.
